reason: 用户认为所有无人物文本都用方块过于单一，要求原站语汇基础上扩充小素材库再组合。

items.title: 开放回环
items.construction: One loose almost-circular electric-blue return loop, open at the upper right with one short arrowhead. Place one small flat pink rectangular tile on the lower arc. Use a slightly irregular but continuous curve, a calm open center and a clear return direction. The whole loop is a reusable connecting motif.
items.semantic_affordances: 回返、反馈、重复检视；是否传达取决于组合落点。

items.title: 折页信息片
items.construction: One upright turquoise information sheet with a diagonally folded upper-right corner. The folded triangular corner is pink and the inner reverse face is white. Use a blue outline and one essential fold line. The plain central plane is broad and empty, without text or UI lines. Slightly tilt the whole sheet to keep its silhouette lively.
items.semantic_affordances: 信息片、试验对象、待处理内容；不固定为文件图标。

items.title: 展开扇片
items.construction: A compact fan of three broad rounded sector-shaped sheets opening around a small common pivot. Give the three slightly offset leaves turquoise, sky-blue and pink flat fills with a blue contour. Keep three distinct outer arcs and clear overlap boundaries; one simple pivot circle is enough. It is an abstract expanding arrangement, not a flower or hand fan product.
items.semantic_affordances: 展开、范围扩大、选择；新扇片构造为原创扩充，非官网原有图。

items.title: 回折连接带
items.construction: One narrow turquoise ribbon-like connector traveling sideways through two soft opposing bends, with an electric-blue outer contour. Its ends are open clean cuts, positioned at the left and right. Keep uniform strip width, a crisp unshaded fill and a readable S-like path. No separate arrowhead, knot or extra object.
items.semantic_affordances: 传递、连接、转向；需要组合时另行确定端点。

items.title: 留白云形容器
items.construction: One hollow cloud-shaped enclosure built from three unequal rounded lobes and a gently curved lower edge. Use a turquoise boundary band enclosed by a continuous electric-blue contour; leave the broad inner area genuinely transparent and empty. Keep it asymmetric and diagrammatic. This is a reusable holding space, without a server, device, face or small symbols.
items.semantic_affordances: 容纳、共享空间或开放边界；内区透明，需按内容放主体。

items.title: 异形接点
items.construction: One small sky-blue rounded triangle on the left and one pink circular disk on the right, separated by breathing space and joined by one loose electric-blue curved line. Let the line visibly touch each shape at one boundary point. Use plain geometric fills, unequal sizes and slightly asymmetric placement. No eyes, mouths or limbs.
items.semantic_affordances: 不同事物的联系、对话或匹配；两个形体不可自动视为人物。

composite_plan: 保留原自然语言短文，选少量实际素材表现小试验、回返调整与扩大范围；实际选用及路径在组合前记录。
source_scope: R12/R05/R03等给出曲线、异形、折页和容器语法；G01–G06的新组合是原创推导。
